change.summary: Use one reviewed schema-2 manifest for all 14,064 item IDs, corrected catalog leaves, and exact companion and transport additional views.

modifiers.before: The initial exact manifest retained broad classifier mistakes and had no exact secondary views.
modifiers.after: All 14,064 registered item IDs have one reviewed primary leaf under the corrected weapon, wearable, food, building, or root tree. Reviewed spawn eggs can also appear in Companions or Transport.

modifiers.before: Armor, mob armor, dolls, tools, sensors, books, and storage items shared one broad leaf.
modifiers.after: Wearables has Armor, Mob Armor, and Cosmetics leaves. The internal WEARABLE_DOLLS leaf presents 765 exact dolls and reviewed effectless decorative heads as Cosmetics.

modifiers.before: Many weapons, shields, plants, containers, cooking tools, Create tools, and companion items appeared in Other or an unrelated leaf.
modifiers.after: Reviewed item families use their exact weapon, shield, nature, container, cooking, Create, building-tool, companion, transport, potion, book, ore, light, block, spawn-egg, music-disc or tree leaf. Archie's Dinosaurs has 7 totems, 7 melee weapons, 3 ranged weapons, 24 armor pieces, 1 food, 1 companion item, 1 book, 4 ore-family items, 1 light and 10 building blocks in semantic leaves.

modifiers.before: Components was a top-level group, music discs shared broader leaves, and wood products were split between Building Materials, Nature, Furniture and Other.
modifiers.after: Components is retired and unspecialized crafting parts use Other. Music Discs is a top-level leaf with 87 items. Trees is a top-level leaf with 1,143 logs, planks, wooden architecture, signs, doors, trapdoors, shelves, trims and reviewed wooden furniture. Leaves, soil, saplings and living plants remain in Building > Nature, while Casual Swing remains in Building > Furniture and Decorations.

modifiers.before: Archie's egg-shaped items had no reviewed semantic distinction.
modifiers.after: All seven ec_ad:*_spawn_egg registry items use Spawn Eggs. ec_ad:sculkraptor_egg also uses Spawn Eggs because it hatches a non-mount creature. The placed hatch eggs ec_ad:chorusoatl_egg, ec_ad:lushsaur_egg, ec_ad:obsidiceratops_egg and ec_ad:therimoss_egg use Transport because the installed behavior produces rideable mounts.

modifiers.before: The optional building-market admission had no Trees leaf.
modifiers.after: JemCatalogCategories admits TREES to the optional JEM Economy building market with the existing Create and building leaves. Music Discs, Cosmetics and Other remain outside building admission.
Original JEI mode leaves the curated overlay invisible, inactive, and unfocused.

modifiers.before: The curated overlay rendered in ScreenEvent.Render.Post, so its grid and search controls could redraw after native item and search-box tooltips and cause frame-to-frame overlap.
modifiers.after: The curated overlay renders at AbstractContainerScreen.renderTooltip HEAD and renders its own hovered tooltip last inside that pass, so the subsequent native tooltip pass remains above the catalog and search controls.

modifiers.before: A JEM index loaded every installed language and tooltip terms, registered aliases in JEI, and rescanned the selected Creative tab after each query change.
modifiers.after: Native JEI and Creative search use their standard active-language behavior without JEM aliases or query interception. The curated category field matches only the current localized hover name and registry ID.

modifiers.before: JEM indexed translated Food Blessing tooltip, trait and effect components as item aliases across all installed languages.
modifiers.after: Food Blessing text remains localized, but JEM does not add blessing search aliases. Native JEI search behavior owns any tooltip search available for the active language.

rationale.purpose: Make category membership complete, stable, reviewable, and aligned with actual item purpose.
rationale.user_requested: Correct weapons and shields, add companions and building tools, split armor, move nature, containers, cooking and Create items, and name the dolls leaf Dolls.
rationale.codex_choices: Keep one primary leaf per ID, use exact additional views only for reviewed spawn eggs, and keep doll stations outside the Dolls leaf.

introduced.summary: Install the complete exact registry manifest.

history.summary: Generate and validate 13,869 unique item assignments.
Correct semantic leaves, add Shields, Companions, Building Tools, Armor, Mob Armor, and Dolls, and add exact companion and transport secondary views.

Review all 14,064 assignments, classify Archie's content and semantic egg families, retire Components, add top-level Music Discs and Trees, present Dolls as Cosmetics with effectless heads, and correct the requested weapon, wearable, tool, light, potion and building examples.
Render the curated catalog before the native tooltip pass. The all-language search extension added in this step was superseded later the same day.

Remove the expensive all-language index, static English aliases and Creative query interception. Native JEI and Creative search again follow the active client language, while the curated field uses the current localized name and registry ID.

relations: logical server item registry -> checked manifest -> direct client lookup
spawn egg primary leaf -> exact companion or transport additional view
Archie's registered egg behavior -> Spawn Eggs or Transport primary leaf
Trees leaf -> optional JEM Economy building admission
leaf category -> optional JEM Economy admission
active client language -> native JEI and Creative search
current localized hover name and registry ID -> curated category search
AbstractContainerScreen tooltip pass -> curated overlay -> native tooltip remains topmost
notes: The final JEMCompat 3.11.5 SHA-256 is 3E6BC7D557E57480D514DB846A21BDA914BC6A46AC8B6078A06F4BB1518C82F3 and is byte-identical in build/libs, ManagedPack and Server.
The current manifest contains 14,064 exact primary assignments. Cosmetics contains 765 IDs, Music Discs contains 87 IDs and Trees contains 1,143 IDs.
